commit.message:
feat(dev): dev server runs against live backend + Cosmos, signed in as you

A vite plugin spawns backend/server.js on an OS-assigned free port (so parallel worktrees don't collide), pointed at live Cosmos (COSMOS_DB_ENDPOINT, passwordless via az login) with DEV_AUTH as the real admin identity, then proxies /api to it. 'npm run dev' alone brings up the full app, logged in, with live data -- no separate backend process, no dev DB.

backend/config.js: COSMOS_DB_ENDPOINT short-circuits the App Config lookup. backend/auth.js: DEV_AUTH bypasses the auth.romaine.life cookie forward. DEV_NO_BACKEND=1 opts out to the frontend-only sql.js snapshot.

All dev-only: the plugin is apply:serve (absent from 'vite build') and the prod backend never sets DEV_AUTH or COSMOS_DB_ENDPOINT, so it is inert in prod.
